scheme_name: Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must have space/shed for keeping milch animals
No mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements
Applicant must submit a Self‑Declaration for unemployment and compliance with scheme conditions
benefits_summary: Provides a 25% subsidy on the cost of two milch animals, disbursed as a loan, along with insurance assistance as per departmental schemes.
